blocks.arabic_text: مَيِّتٌ فَآذِنُونِي، وَصَلَّي عَلَيْهَا، وَقَالَ: إِنِّي رَأَيْتُهَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ لِمَا كَانَتْ تَلْقُطُ الْقَذَي مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير ورجاله رجال الصحيح مجمع الزوائد:٢ /١١٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates, “A woman used to remove the rubbish and litter from the masjid. That woman died, and the news of her burial was not conveyed to the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ said, “If anyone among you dies, inform me.” After that, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed the Janazah Salah for that woman and said, “Because this woman used to clean the rubbish and litter from the masjid, I saw her in Jannah.”
